WHO WE ARE 
 
 Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers.   
   
  At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest.  
   
 When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.  
   
 Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.  
   
 We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received:  
   
 Best Places to Work   
 2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn  
   
 WealthTech of the Year   
 2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards  
   
 The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies   
 2024 - Presented by CNBC  
 
 ABOUT THIS ROLE 
 
 Job Description 
 Apex Fintech Solutions is seeking a Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and manage the cloud infrastructure and foundational services that power our financial products. You will work alongside a talented team of platform engineers under the guidance of senior technical leaders to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

 This is a hands-on individual contributor role ideal for an engineer with solid cloud infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code experience who is eager to deepen their expertise in platform and cloud engineering within a fast-paced fintech environment. 

 Duties/Responsibilities 
 Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure on GCP using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices 
 Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules, templates, and patterns that enable engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure safely and consistently 
 Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, ensuring reliable and repeatable delivery of cloud resources 
 Manage and optimize GCP services including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Cloud Storage 
 Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve cloud infrastructure reliability and performance issues, contributing to incident response as needed 
 Implement and enforce cloud security best practices including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption, and compliance controls 
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to understand their infrastructure needs and deliver effective, well-architected cloud solutions 
 Contribute to reducing operational toil through automation, self-service tooling, and process improvements 
 Maintain infrastructure documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures 
 Stay current with GCP services, Terraform releases, and emerging cloud-native technologies and practices 
 Support cost optimization efforts by monitoring cloud spend and recommending right-sizing and efficiency improvements 
 
 Education and/or Experience 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent work experience) 
 3-5 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or DevOps 
 Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform required — GCP preferred (GKE, Cloud SQL, IAM, VPC, Pub/Sub) or AWS (EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda) 
 Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management 
 Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE) 
 Experience with CI/CD tools and deployment automation, particularly GitHub Actions 
 Exposure to data orchestration platforms (e.g., Apache Airflow) is a plus 
 Experience with disaster recovery planning, multi-environment resilience, or FinOps practices is a plus 
 
 Required Skills/Abilities 
 Strong proficiency in Terraform (modules, state management, workspaces) and IaC best practices 
 Solid understanding of cloud services across GCP (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, IAM, VPC, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging/Monitoring) or equivalent AWS services 
 Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and VPN/interconnect 
 Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation and tooling — not a heavy software development role 
 Understanding of cloud security principles including least-privilege IAM, network security, encryption at rest/in transit, and compliance frameworks 
 Experience managing or supporting CI/CD infrastructure including GitHub Actions workflows and runners 
 Understanding of infrastructure compliance requirements and the ability to implement controls to meet regulatory and audit standards 
 Solid understanding of DevOps and SRE principles including CI/CD, GitOps, and deployment strategies 
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues 
 Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering teams 
 Ownership mentality with personal accountability and attention to detail 
 Eagerness to learn new cloud technologies and adapt to a rapidly evolving infrastructure landscape 
 
 Preferred Skills/Abilities 
 Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) 
 Familiarity with data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow 
 Understanding of FinOps principles — cloud cost allocation, tagging strategies, budgeting, and right-sizing recommendations 
 Awareness of disaster recovery (DR) strategies, multi-environment architecture, and infrastructure resilience patterns 
 Financial services or regulated environment experience 
 Familiarity with financial systems, trading and accounting concepts, and compliance within regulated environments 
 Cloud certifications (GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, GCP Professional Cloud Engineer, AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Solutions Architect Associate) 
 
 Work Environment 
 This job operates in a hybrid, office environment 3 days per week. 
 #engineering #mid-level #full-time #APEX 
 
 ​ Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 
 
 
 Our Rewards 
 
 We offer a robust package of employee perks and benefits, including healthcare benefits (medical, dental and vision, EAP), competitive PTO, 401k match, parental leave, and HSA contribution match. We also provide our employees with a paid subscription to the Calm app and offer generous external learning and tuition reimbursement benefits. At AFS, we offer a hybrid work schedule for most roles that allows employees to have the flexibility of working from home and one of our primary offices. 
 
 EEO Statement 
 
 Apex Fintech Solutions is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring practices ensure that all qualified applicants receive fair consideration without regard to these characteristics.
 
 Disability Statement 
 
 Apex Fintech Solutions is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all candidates, including those with disabilities. We are dedicated to ensuring equal employment opportunities and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request via the Candidate Accommodation Requests Form . We will work with you to provide the necessary accommodations to ensure your full participation in our hiring process.
